$schema: Docwriter manual-family task graph — augments existing VS Code agent family with 3 extensions
description: Adds meta-knowledge base, internet research gate, and knowledge synthesis to the existing manually-deployed docwriter agent family. All 30 tasks implemented — 7 agents created, 9 modified, 2 docs updated, bootstrap extended.
assumptions: 22 base docwriter agents already exist as .github/agents/docwriter*.agent.md
docwriter-bootstrap.sh already exists and creates .docwriter/ directory
VS Code Copilot Chat is the invocation surface (human types @docwriter)
No orchestrator, Docker, Liquid templates, or JIRA integration
Meta-knowledge persists repo-local (.docwriter/meta/ committed or gitignored by user)
Internet access is direct (user's network), fetch tool available in Copilot

tasks.title: Modify docwriter-bootstrap.sh — meta directories + seed files
tasks.description: Add .docwriter/meta/ subdirectories (patterns, anti-patterns, domain-insights, task-retros, style-evolutions), .docwriter/synthesis-signals/, seed meta/index.json and meta/research-sources.json (5 curated sources), add pass0/pass65 to progress.json schema.
acceptanceCriteria: bootstrap creates .docwriter/meta/ with all 5 subdirectories
bootstrap creates .docwriter/synthesis-signals/
meta/index.json seeded with version 1, empty entries array
meta/research-sources.json seeded with 5 curated URL sources
progress.json includes pass0_knowledgeCuration and pass6_5_knowledgeSynthesis

tasks.title: Create placeholder docwriter-meta skill directory
tasks.description: Create .github/skills/docwriter-meta/ with SKILL.md (frontmatter + reference table) and 5 placeholder reference files.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md has valid frontmatter (name, description)
All 5 reference files exist with placeholder content
Placeholder text references docwriter-skill-rebuilder as generator

tasks.title: Add --clean re-run mode to bootstrap
tasks.description: --clean flag deletes everything EXCEPT meta/ then re-creates core artifacts. No flag = existing error behavior. Ensures meta/ persists across teardown-rebuild cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running with --clean preserves meta/ while resetting core artifacts
No --clean flag with existing .docwriter/ exits with current error
No existing .docwriter/ performs full fresh bootstrap

tasks.title: Create docwriter-knowledge-curator.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist for Pass 0 (direct orchestrator dispatch). 7-step curation: read index → task profile → multi-factor relevance scoring (domain 40%, confidence 25%, recency 20%, usage 15%) → consumer-aware grouping → read entries (max 20, saturation guard) → staleness/conflict detection → knowledge-brief.json. Cold-start produces empty brief.
acceptanceCriteria: VS Code frontmatter (description, model: Claude Opus 4.6 (copilot), name, user-invocable: false)
Multi-factor relevance scoring with threshold ≥0.4
Saturation guard caps brief at 20 entries
Consumer-aware grouping (patterns/anti-patterns, domain-insights/style-evolutions, retro lessons)
Staleness detection (stale >90d/<3 uses, decaying >180d, contradicted)
Cold-start produces valid empty brief with taskProfile
Read-only against meta/ — never modifies index or entries

tasks.title: Define knowledge-brief.json contract
tasks.description: Document the output schema for knowledge-brief.json and 6 curation quality principles.
acceptanceCriteria: knowledge-brief.json schema fully specified with all sections
Each entry includes id, title, insight, applicability, confidence, relevanceScore, consumers
Summary includes counts, threshold, truncated flag, coldStart flag

tasks.title: Create docwriter-research-scout.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist dispatched at Pass 2 Step 2b (parallel with code-analyzer). 5-step: derive queries → fetch curated sources (max 8) → extract recommendations with REC-NNN IDs → invariant gate → research-brief.json. Non-blocking failure mode.
acceptanceCriteria: VS Code frontmatter
Every recommendation has invariantCheck (approved/blocked/adapted)
Blocked recommendations excluded from downstream list
Fetch failures produce valid empty brief
Max 8 fetches, no hallucinated recommendations

tasks.title: Modify analysis-coordinator — add research-scout + reorder Pass 2
tasks.description: Reorder Pass 2: Step 1 invariant-scanner → Step 2a code-analyzer + Step 2b research-scout (parallel) → Step 3 impact-mapper. Non-blocking failure for research-scout.
acceptanceCriteria: research-scout added to agents array in frontmatter
Pass 2 dispatches invariant-scanner BEFORE code-analyzer + research-scout
Research-scout failure is non-blocking

tasks.title: Document research-sources.json schema
tasks.description: Document the source entry schema for future evolution by knowledge-integrator.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema documented with all fields and semantics
effectiveness field documented as synthesizer-updated

tasks.title: Create docwriter-synthesis-coordinator.agent.md
tasks.description: New coordinator for Pass 6.5 (direct orchestrator dispatch). Sequential dispatch: task-signal-analyzer → context-signal-analyzer → knowledge-integrator → skill-rebuilder. Degraded-mode handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontmatter has agents array with 4 subagents
Sequential dispatch with validation between steps
Degraded mode on signal analyzer failure

tasks.title: Create docwriter-task-signal-analyzer.agent.md
tasks.description: Synthesis Step 1. Signals A1 (first-attempt success → patterns), A2 (multi-cycle failure → anti-patterns), A3 (style evolution). Writes synthesis-signals/task-signals.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Signal A1: first-attempt success analysis
Signal A2: multi-cycle failure root cause
Signal A3: style evolution from reviewer feedback
Writes task-signals.json with runStats, per-task signals, styleEvolutions

tasks.title: Create docwriter-context-signal-analyzer.agent.md
tasks.description: Synthesis Step 2. Signals B1 (gap findings), B2 (domain insights), B3 (research effectiveness), B4 (meta-knowledge effectiveness). Writes synthesis-signals/context-signals.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Signal B1: gap findings (predictable vs. novel)
Signal B3: research effectiveness per source
Signal B4: meta-knowledge effectiveness

tasks.title: Create docwriter-knowledge-integrator.agent.md
tasks.description: Synthesis Step 3. Confidence calibration → dedup → quality gate → write entries → update index → task retro → update research-sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Confidence calibration follows strict ladder
Deduplication uses type + title + domain overlap
Entry files include Provenance and How to Apply sections
Additive-only: no entries deleted, only deprecated

tasks.title: Create docwriter-skill-rebuilder.agent.md
tasks.description: Synthesis Step 4. Full-rebuild of 5 reference files + SKILL.md header from meta index + entries.
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 reference files fully regenerated (full rebuild, never incremental)
Entries grouped by domain, ordered by confidence then usage
SKILL.md header includes running stats

tasks.title: Modify docwriter-task-planner — consume briefs + meta-skill
tasks.description: Add knowledge-brief.json + research-brief.json + skill patterns/anti-patterns as optional inputs. Pattern-derived acceptance criteria (PAT-NNN), research recommendations (REC-NNN).

tasks.title: Modify docwriter-style-reviewer — consume anti-patterns + style evolutions
Modify docwriter-accuracy-reviewer — consume domain insights + research
Modify docwriter-gap-hunter — consume historical failure data
Modify docwriter-risk-analyzer — add research alignment dimension
Add invariant supremacy rule to all 7 modified agents
Update docwriter.agent.md agents array
tasks.description: Add knowledge-curator and synthesis-coordinator to the orchestrator's agents array.

tasks.title: Update routing table to 9 rows — add Pass 0 + Pass 6.5
Update re-entry logic — skip Pass 0 and Pass 6.5
Add post-dispatch actions for Pass 0 and Pass 6.5
Update pipeline completion summary with meta/research/skill metrics
